Name: VALLEY GIRLS(stardew Valley expanded compatibility)
Author: Eli0630
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
I saw that the original author of Valley Girls, TrashRacc, hadn't updated the expanded version of his mod, so I decided to update it myself👐
This mod adds sexual content to the female NPCS's(including characters from Stardew Valley Expanded such as Sophia and Olivia).
Oh, and in case you're wondering, I'll only permanently remove this mod if the original author wants me to take it down. Otherwise, I plan to publish this mod elsewhere.
*Note:The mod is not compatible with the base Valley Girls mod or Harem Valley, as it causes conflicts between both the mods and the maps*
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Install this mod according to its requirements, then paste this and the other mods into the SMAPI mods folder, and it should work. 

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]-This mod adds sexual content to the female NPCS's(including characters from Stardew Valley Expanded such as Sophia and Olivia) [/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]- i18n support[/color]
